title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20
lineage: Sennheiser 421's (18th row - Center) > Sony TC-D5 > Master Cassette > Playback on Nak Dragon > Sony R700 DAT deck (sbm-on) - used only as A>D converter (44.1khz) > ZA2 > CDR (x1)  > EAC(tracked with Addawav & CDWav) >SHN

ai_review.summary: Energetic Madison Square Garden show with standout Jerry Garcia work, but the recording is uneven and missing the Touch of Grey encore.
ai_review.review: The performance captures a high‑energy NY night where Jerry’s guitar and vocals are described as crisp and inspired, and the setlist hits many fan favorites. However listeners note that the tape suffers from inconsistent levels, occasional muffling and the omission of the Touch of Grey encore, making the listening experience only fair.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews praise the musical performance (especially Jerry) but criticize the recording’s inconsistencies and missing encore; combined weighting yields an average‑to‑good rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Missing Touch of Grey encore, inconsistent volume/clarity ("travesty" comment), but some listeners note crispness in Jerry’s guitar and vocals; overall uneven listening experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set list considered a fan‑dream ‘wish list’ for early‑80s shows, with strong energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised as crisp, sharp, and brilliant; vocal performance noted as fantastic though slightly cracked on "Fire".
